about_the_game:
Ludus Magnatus: Gladiator Manager Simulator is a classic management experience set in an alternate Ancient Rome.

Start in Division VII with one of sixteen clubs, recruit fighters, equip them from the market, and climb the ladder through fully simulated seasons and matches. Build momentum, overcome rival ludi, and carry your team toward promotion, knowing every battle can make legends… or end careers.

Fully Simulated World
No rubber-banding, no secret boosts. AI clubs play by the same rules, earn the same gold, and develop gladiators exactly as you do.

In-Depth Gladiator Customization
Outfit your fighters with armor and weapons to suit your plan. Watch them grow with form and experience—but don’t get too attached; the arena is unforgiving.

Engaging Matches
Every fixture unfolds in 3D, putting you ringside as your team performs before a roaring crowd clear, where your management decisions comes to life at center stage.

content_descriptors.notes: Females are topless if not equipped with a chest piece armour. Can also be toggled on/off in the settings menu.
